sloka: अयं हि सुरसैन्यस्य त्रैलोक्यस्य च यः प्रभुः ।स गृहीतो दैवबलाद्भग्नदर्पाः सुराः कृताः ।। ७.२९.३६ ॥
transliteration: ayaṁ hi surasainyasya trailokyasya ca yaḥ prabhuḥ ।sa gṛhīto daivabalādbhagnadarpāḥ surāḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 7.29.36 ॥

translations.english: "Indeed, this one who is the lord of the army of gods and of the three worlds has been captured by divine power, and thus the gods have been rendered with broken pride."
